Amazon Pledges $1 Billion for Data Center Communities

Amazon has announced a commitment to invest $1 billion over five years into communities where it operates data centers. This investment is intended to foster community support amid backlash and concerns regarding the rollout of these facilities. The company's move aims to gain buy-in for its data center expansion plans.
